name: Margravial Opera House Bayreuth
description: The Margravial Opera House in Bayreuth, Germany, is a lavish Baroque theatre built between 1745 and 1750 for Margravine Wilhelmine and designed by Giuseppe Galli Bibiena. Its tiers of boxes are made of wood and painted canvas, still in their original materials. Seating about 500, it lets visitors experience court opera much as audiences did in the 18th century.
